metaDescription: Bake espresso vanilla cupcakes with caramel buttercream and drizzle. Easy step-by-step plan ready in 43 minutes, get the recipe now.
ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter, softened, for frosting
1/2 cup store bought caramel sauce, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a 12 cup muffin pan with paper liners.
Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl. Set aside.
Dissolve espresso powder in hot water. Let it cool slightly.
Beat butter and sugar together until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each. Mix in vanilla and espresso liquid.
Add flour mix and milk in three additions, alternating. Mix just until smooth.
Divide batter evenly among liners, filling each about two thirds full.
Bake 16 to 18 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool in pan 5 minutes, then move to a rack.
For frosting, beat butter until creamy. Add powdered sugar in batches, then mix in 1/4 cup caramel sauce, vanilla, and salt.
Once cupcakes are fully cool, pipe caramel buttercream in a tall swirl on each one.
Warm the remaining caramel sauce slightly and drizzle over each swirl before serving.
tips: Use room temperature eggs and butter so the batter mixes smooth without lumps.
Do not skip cooling the cupcakes fully before frosting, or the buttercream will melt and slide.
For a stronger coffee kick, add an extra 1/2 tsp espresso powder to the batter.
Warm caramel sauce for about 10 seconds in the microwave so it drizzles instead of clumps.
conclusion: These caramel latte cupcakes turn your morning coffee order into a dessert. Make a batch for brunch or gift a few to your favorite coffee lover.

faq.question: Can I use brewed coffee instead of espresso powder?
faq.answer: Espresso powder works best because it adds flavor without extra liquid. If you use brewed coffee, cut the milk by 2 tablespoons to keep the batter from getting too wet.

faq.question: Why did my caramel buttercream turn out runny?
faq.answer: This usually means your caramel sauce was too warm or your butter was too soft. Chill the frosting bowl for 10 minutes and rebeat before piping.

faq.question: Can I make the caramel buttercream ahead of time?
faq.answer: Yes, make it up to 2 days ahead and store covered in the fridge. Let it sit at room temperature for 30 minutes, then rebeat before piping.

faq.question: How do I stop the caramel drizzle from sliding off the frosting?
faq.answer: Let the drizzle cool for a minute after warming so it is thick, not thin. Pipe the buttercream swirl tall first so the caramel has somewhere to sit.
